name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
June 10, 2014
08:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 200 Civic Center Drive, Vista, California
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Commander Haywood Bagley, American Legion Post 365
Recommended Action:
. *3
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Lifesaver Award Presentation to Kellie Hodawanus, Out & About Bus Driver.
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/SA/BSD)
C3.
Treasurer's Cash Report for Month Ending April 30, 2014 (CC)
C4.
Adoption of the Fiscal Year 2014-2015 Appropriation Limit (CC)
C5.
Delegating Investment Authority to the City Treasurer for Fiscal Year 2014/15 and Re-Adopting City Council Policy 700-07, Investment of City Funds (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2014- , delegating investment authority; and
2.
Re-adopt City Council Policy 700-07.
C6.
November 4, 2014, General Municipal Election (CC)
C7.
Encina Wastewater Authority Budget for Fiscal Year 2014-15 (CC/BSD)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2014- ; and
2.
Buena Sanitation District Resolution No. 2014- .
C8.
Management and Confidential Employee Compensation Plan Amendments (CC)
C9.
Appointments to Various Commissions, Boards and Committees (CC)
1.
Confirm the Mayor's annual appointments to various commissions, boards, and committees;
2.
Appoint one member recommended by the Mayor to the Planning Commission; and
3.
Confirm the Mayor's appointment to fill the unscheduled vacancy on the Community Safety Commission.
C10.
North County Economic Development Collaborative Model (CC)
C11.
Federal Accessibility Plans (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2014- , approving the Title VI Compliance Program;
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2014- , approving the Limited English Proficiency (LEP) Plan; and
3.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2014- , approving the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990 ("ADA") and Section 504 Rehabilitation Act of 1973 Plan.
C12.
Fiscal Year 2014/15 Operating Budget (CC/CDC/BSD)
1.
Adopt the following, approving the Annual Operating Budget:
a.
City Council Resolution No. 2014- ;
b.
Buena Sanitation District Resolution No. 2014- ;
and
c.
Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2014- .
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2014- , amending the City-Wide Classification and Compensation Index. ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR FOR DISCUSSION
DISCUSSION
D1.
2014 Candidates’ Statements of Qualifications (CC)
1.
Establish the maximum number of words, 200 or 400, to be permitted in a Candidate's Statement of Qualifications for the offices of Mayor and Member
of the City Council at the November 4, 2014, General Municipal Election; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2014- , adopting regulations for candidates' statements to be submitted to the voters for the November 4, 2014, General Municipal Election.
D2.
Five-Year Capital Improvement Program (CIP) and Fiscal Year 2014/15 Capital Improvement Project Budget (CC/BSD)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2014- ;
2.
Buena Sanitation District Resolution No. 2014- ; and
3.
Successor Agency Resolution No. 2014- .
PUBLIC HEARINGS
PH1.
Appeal of PC 14-299, Santa Fe Vista Apartments located at 1375 S. Santa Fe Avenue (CC)
1.
Open, conduct, and close a Public Hearing to consider an appeal of Planning Case No. 14-299;
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2014- , certifying the project Environmental Impact Report, adopting Environmental Findings and a Statement of Overriding Considerations pursuant to the California Environmental Quality Act, and adopting a Mitigation Monitoring and Reporting Program for 114 multi-family apartment units and associated site improvements; and
3.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2014- , approving a Site Development Plan with a Density Bonus for 114 multi-family apartment units and associated site improvements.
PH2.
Collection of Delinquent Sewer Service Charges (CC/BSD)
1.
Open, conduct, and close a Public Hearing to receive public testimony; and
2.
Adopt the following memorializing the sewer service charge for FY 2014/15 and approving liens on assessor's parcels to be collected with the general property taxes on the FY 2014/15 tax roll for unpaid sewer service charges:
a.
City Council Resolution No. 2014- , in accordance with City Ordinance No. 2013-4; and
b.
Buena Sanitation District Resolution No. 2014- ,
in accordance with District Ordinance No. 2013-1.
PH3.
Levy of Delinquent FY 2013/14 Property Related Administrative Citation Charges (CC)
1.
Open, conduct, and close a Public Hearing to receive public testimony; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2014- , approving liens on assessor's parcels within the City of Vista to be collected with the general property taxes on the FY 2014/15 property tax roll for delinquent property related administrative citations.
PH4.
Collection of Delinquent 2013 Weed Abatement Charges (CC)
1.
Open, conduct, and close a Public Hearing to receive public testimony; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2014- , approving and confirming a report and account for abatement of weeds, shrubs, dead trees, and waste matter for FY 2013/14.
PH5.
Levy of Assessments for Fiscal Year 2014/15 (CC)
1.
Open, conduct, and close a Public Hearing to receive public testimony;
2.
Adopt the following, providing for annual assessment levies:
a.
City Council Resolution No. 2014- , for City of
Vista Landscape and Lighting District No. 1;
b.
City Council Resolution No. 2014- , for City of
Vista Street Maintenance District No. 1; and
c.
City Council Resolution No. 2014- , for the South Melrose Drive Landscape Maintenance District.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
